options.option: No elapsed-time expiry; keep revocation on permission changes and allow signing-key lifecycle policy to invalidate tokens.
options.tradeoff: Recommended security boundary: links last indefinitely during stable authorization/key state, but are intentionally not irrevocable.

options.option: No elapsed-time expiry and survive signing-key rotation; keep revocation on permission changes.
options.tradeoff: Links remain durable through routine rotation, requiring explicit old-key retention or token migration while preserving authorization revocation.

options.option: Survive elapsed time, permission changes, and signing-key rotation.
options.tradeoff: Strongest permanence, but permission removal and routine key retirement cannot invalidate access; this creates critical authorization and key-compromise risk and needs a separate emergency revocation design.
